g.text: Same latent, two decoders, four full-length covers
Time-averaged spectra in 1/12-octave bands. In the shaded band above 8 kHz Fugue sits at or above the native decode of the same latent. Both stay under the
commercially mastered source around 1–4 kHz; these covers are unmastered. Curves stop at 16 kHz so lossless renders and MP3 previews remain comparable.
